package domain

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestNewStudentLearningActionNormalizesTargetSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	openedAt := time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.FixedZone("test", 5*60*60))
	action, err := NewStudentLearningAction(StudentLearningAction{
		ID:                  "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		StudentTaskAnswerID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		StudentID:           "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		TaskID:              "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		ContextType:         LearningContextLessonTask,
		ContextID:           "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		LearningTargets: []LearningTargetRef{
			{Type: LearningTargetCapability, Key: " learning.semantic-sequence ", Version: " v1 "},
		},
		EvidenceClass: LearningEvidenceApplication,
		OpenedAt:      openedAt,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewStudentLearningAction returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if action.ID == action.StudentTaskAnswerID {
		t.Fatal("learning action identity must be distinct from answer identity")
	}
	if action.OpenedAt.Location() != time.UTC {
		t.Fatalf("opened_at location = %v, want UTC", action.OpenedAt.Location())
	}
	if len(action.LearningTargets) != 1 || action.LearningTargets[0].Key != "learning.semantic-sequence" || action.LearningTargets[0].Version != "v1" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected target snapshot: %+v", action.LearningTargets)
	}
}

func TestLearningActionClosedEventExcludesObjectiveOutcome(t *testing.T) {
	closedAt := time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 8, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	action, err := NewStudentLearningAction(StudentLearningAction{
		ID:                  "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		StudentTaskAnswerID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		StudentID:           "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		TaskID:              "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		ContextType:         LearningContextLessonTask,
		ContextID:           "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		LearningTargets: []LearningTargetRef{
			{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "program.instructions.sequence"},
		},
		EvidenceClass: LearningEvidenceKnowledgeCheck,
		OpenedAt:      closedAt.Add(-10 * time.Minute),
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewStudentLearningAction returned error: %v", err)
	}
	event, err := NewLearningActionClosedEvent(
		"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		action,
		closedAt,
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewLearningActionClosedEvent returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if event.Subject != SubjectLearningActionClosed || event.CorrelationID != action.ID || event.CausationID != action.StudentTaskAnswerID {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected event identity: %+v", event)
	}
	for _, forbidden := range [][]byte{[]byte(`"status"`), []byte(`"passed"`), []byte(`"score"`), []byte(`"mastery"`)} {
		if bytes.Contains(event.Payload, forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("closure payload contains forbidden objective field %s: %s", forbidden, event.Payload)
		}
	}

	var envelope EventEnvelope
	if err := json.Unmarshal(event.Payload, &envelope); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode event envelope: %v", err)
	}
	if envelope.EventID != event.EventID || envelope.EventType != SubjectLearningActionClosed || envelope.SchemaVersion != LearningActionClosedSchemaVersion {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected envelope: %+v", envelope)
	}
}

func TestNewStudentLearningActionRejectsDuplicateTargets(t *testing.T) {
	_, err := NewStudentLearningAction(StudentLearningAction{
		ID:                  "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		StudentTaskAnswerID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		StudentID:           "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		TaskID:              "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		ContextType:         LearningContextLessonTask,
		ContextID:           "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		LearningTargets: []LearningTargetRef{
			{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "program.instructions.sequence"},
			{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "program.instructions.sequence"},
		},
		EvidenceClass: LearningEvidenceApplication,
		OpenedAt:      time.Now(),
	})
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected duplicate target validation error")
	}
}

func TestNewStudentLearningActionRequiresEvidenceClassAndNoOutcome(t *testing.T) {
	input := StudentLearningAction{
		ID:                  "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		StudentTaskAnswerID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		StudentID:           "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		TaskID:              "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		ContextType:         LearningContextLessonTask,
		ContextID:           "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		OpenedAt:            time.Now(),
	}
	if _, err := NewStudentLearningAction(input); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected missing evidence class error")
	}
	input.EvidenceClass = LearningEvidenceApplication
	input.Outcome = LearningActionPassed
	input.OutcomePolicyVersion = MasteryPolicyVersion
	if _, err := NewStudentLearningAction(input); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected open action outcome error")
	}
}
